bio_long: Malav Naik is a Data & GenAI Engineer based in Dublin, Ireland, with about 10 years of experience in data. At S&P Global Market Intelligence (2019–2024) he built SSIS pipelines for financial data and helped migrate on-premise SQL Server to Azure SQL, cutting infrastructure costs by about 25%. He holds an MSc in Data Analytics from National College of Ireland, with a thesis on knowledge graphs and prompt engineering. He now works as an Escalation Operations Analyst at Accenture, with a global technology client. His public projects include a tested dbt and DuckDB data pipeline, a content moderation classifier with fairness checks, and LLM tools that act only after human approval. He is open to AI Engineer, Applied AI Engineer and Forward Deployed Engineer roles in Dublin.
